svg.text: The 02:00 maintenance window: sixteen drain runs, how many inference requests?
every run is active for the whole window; the model sees only the cyan parts. Gaps drawn from the Codex traces: 5.2 s median, 81 s P99.
model call: a request in flight
dispatch: one run checks three member nodes at once
16: one request per active run, if agents were chat sessions
started together at 02:00: the burst a scheduled trigger produces
16 drain runs active throughout. Requests in flight: median 4, peak 12. Peaks are runs started together, tools finishing together, or one run checking member nodes in parallel.
